title: IT / 數據工程職場英文

exercises.prompt: 在站會上，你想說「我卡在上游 schema 異動，等 analytics team 確認新欄位名稱」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: I'm blocked on the upstream schema change — waiting on the analytics team to confirm the new field names.
I finished the upstream schema change already, no problem.
The analytics team blocked me, I don't know why.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: 對，用 blocked on X 來描述被卡住的原因，再用 waiting on Y 補充你在等誰確認，是站會回報最常見的句型。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: 這句要傳達「還沒完成、卡在等別人確認」，(b) 講的是已完成，(c) 語氣像是在抱怨對方，都不合適。

exercises.prompt: 你在 code review 留言，想請對方把 PR 拆小一點，因為它同時動到 ingestion 邏輯跟 schema，哪一句最適合？

options.text: Could you split this PR into smaller commits? It's touching both the ingestion logic and the schema at once.
This PR is too big, please fix it.
You should not touch ingestion logic and schema together, never.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: 用 Could you...? 加上具體原因，是 code review 留言常見又不失禮貌的講法。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 太籠統也偏命令語氣，(c) 用 never 太重、像是在訓話，不適合同事之間的 review 留言。

exercises.prompt: 你在 Slack 上想提醒同事「昨天部署後儀表板的數字怪怪的，想知道有沒有其他人也發現」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: Just flagging that the dashboard numbers look off since yesterday's deploy — anyone else seeing this?
The dashboard is broken, someone fix it now.
I think the deploy is wrong but I am not sure who did it.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: Just flagging that... 是很自然的「先提醒一下、不預設誰的錯」講法，後面再用問句邀請其他人一起確認。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 語氣太強硬像是在指責，(c) 暗示在追究責任，都不是提醒問題時的合適語氣。

exercises.prompt: 跟非工程背景的 stakeholder 開會，你想說「簡單來說，延遲是廠商那邊的問題，不是我們的」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: To put it simply, the delay is on the vendor's side, not ours.
Simply speaking, the vendor is very bad at their job.
It's not our fault, don't ask us again.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: To put it simply 是跟非技術背景的人說明重點時很自然的開場，後面直接點出責任歸屬但語氣中性。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 直接批評廠商顯得不專業，(c) 語氣防禦又不禮貌，都不適合對 stakeholder 說。

exercises.prompt: 你明天請假，想在 Slack 提醒同事「有急事請找某某同事」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: Heads up, I'll be OOO tomorrow, so please loop in Sarah if anything urgent comes up.
I will not be here tomorrow, don't contact me for any reason.
Tomorrow I am off, ask someone else maybe.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: Heads up 是常見的「提醒一下」開場，OOO（out of office）+ loop in someone 是職場上請假交接的標準講法。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 語氣過於強硬，(c) 太口語、沒有明確交代誰可以聯絡，都不夠專業。

exercises.prompt: 你發現 source 端 schema 有 drift，導致 ingestion job 默默把欄位丟掉了，想跟同事說明，哪一句最適合？

options.text: We're seeing schema drift from the source system, so the ingestion job is silently dropping columns.
The source system changed something and now columns disappeared, very strange.
Someone changed the schema and broke everything.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: schema drift 是資料工程常用術語，silently dropping columns 精準描述「沒有噴錯但資料悄悄不見了」這個現象。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 用字太口語模糊，(c) 語氣像是在怪罪某人，且沒說清楚實際發生了什麼技術問題。

exercises.prompt: 你想跟同事解釋「這個 job 是冪等的，失敗後重跑是安全的」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: This job is idempotent, so re-running it after a failure is safe.
This job can run many times, I think it's fine.
If it fails just run it again and again until it works.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: idempotent 是資料工程的關鍵字，直接點出「重跑安全」的技術理由，比模糊帶過更有說服力。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 用 I think 顯得不確定，(c) 聽起來像是碰運氣重試，沒有說明真正原因。

exercises.prompt: 你想說明「這次先用 feature flag 上線，比較保險」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: We're rolling this out behind a feature flag first, just to be safe.
We will turn it on for everyone and see what happens.
This feature flag thing is just extra work but okay.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: roll out behind a feature flag 是描述漸進式上線策略的標準講法，just to be safe 說明保守做法的原因。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 描述的其實是完全相反的做法（直接全開），(c) 語氣顯得不情願、不專業。

exercises.prompt: 你發現一個查詢在掃全表，想建議「應該要按日期分區」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: This query is scanning the full table — we should partition it by date.
This query is very slow, maybe do something about the table.
The table is too big, somebody should split it.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: 先指出具體技術現象（scanning the full table），再提出具體解法（partition by date），是效能討論中清楚又可執行的講法。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b)(c) 都只模糊描述「很慢」「太大」，沒有指出根因跟具體建議，說服力不足。

exercises.prompt: 你們碰到 API 的 rate limit，想說明「需要加上 backoff 跟重試邏輯」，哪一句最適合？

options.text: We're hitting rate limits on the API, so we need to add backoff and retry logic.
The API keeps blocking us, this API is bad.
We call the API too much, maybe call it less.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: hitting rate limits 是精確的技術描述，backoff and retry logic 是業界標準的因應做法，兩者放在一起邏輯清楚。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 把問題怪在 API 本身不夠客觀，(c) 沒有提出具體的技術解法，只是模糊建議少用。

exercises.prompt: 同事回報一個 bug，你這邊重現不出來，想問對方要觸發問題的確切輸入，哪一句最適合？

options.text: I can't reproduce it on my end — do you have the exact input that triggered this?
It doesn't happen for me, so maybe it's not a real bug.
Send me everything about this bug right now.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: 先誠實說明現況（重現不出來），再具體要求關鍵資訊（exact input），是排查問題時最有效率的溝通方式。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 太早否定對方回報的問題，(c) 語氣生硬又沒說清楚要什麼資訊，都不利於合作排查。

exercises.prompt: 你找到 bug 的原因是迴圈條件裡的差一錯誤，想跟同事說明，哪一句最適合？

options.text: It's an off-by-one error in the loop condition.
The loop is wrong somewhere, I'm not sure exactly where.
The number is one more or one less, that's the whole bug.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: off-by-one error 是程式除錯的標準術語，直接點出問題類型跟位置（loop condition），精準又專業。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 完全沒有指出具體原因，等於沒有 debug 結論，(c) 描述方式太口語不精確。

exercises.prompt: 你發現目前找到的錯誤訊息只是表徵、還不是根因，想提醒團隊繼續往下查，哪一句最適合？

options.text: This is a symptom, not the root cause — let's keep digging.
This error is fake, ignore it completely.
We found the error, so the bug is basically solved.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: symptom 跟 root cause 是 debug 討論中常見的對比概念，keep digging 則清楚表達「還沒結束、要繼續查」的態度。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 說錯誤訊息是假的並不準確，它只是不完整，(c) 把「找到表徵」誤當成「問題已解決」，會誤導團隊提早停手。

exercises.prompt: 昨晚出了一個 P1，pipeline 因為一筆格式錯誤的資料整批失敗，你想跟團隊回報，哪一句最適合？

options.text: We had a P1 last night — the pipeline choked on a malformed record and the whole batch failed.
Something very bad happened last night with the pipeline, everything is broken.
The pipeline failed because of one bad record, not a big deal.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: P1、choked on a malformed record 這些用詞精確描述了嚴重程度跟直接原因，適合正式的 incident 回報。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 用詞誇張卻沒有實際資訊，(c) 把整批失敗的 P1 事件輕描淡寫成「沒什麼大不了」，低估了嚴重性。

exercises.prompt: 你修完一個 bug，也驗證過了，並加了 regression test 避免再犯，想跟團隊回報，哪一句最適合？

options.text: Fixed and verified — added a regression test so it doesn't come back.
I think I fixed it, probably it's okay now.
The bug is gone, no need to test again.

exercises.feedbackCorrect: Fixed and verified 清楚交代「已修好且已驗證」，加上 regression test 說明有做長期防範，是完整的收尾回報。
exercises.feedbackIncorrect: (b) 用 probably 顯得沒有把握，不像已經驗證過，(c) 完全沒提驗證跟防範措施，容易讓人誤以為草率結案。
